name: Shain Ryokou de Roten Buro ni Itta Kon'yakusha ga Kaette Konai!
original_name: 社員旅行で露天風呂に行った婚約者が帰ってこない!
source:
Voyeurism on a corporate holiday that could end in...
love?
betrayal?
new love?

Peep on ladies in the bathroom, the floors of the spa hotel, the bathing area, the rec room...
